story.title: Game of CAMOUFLAGE
paragraphs_en: Can you spot the hare in the photo? Look carefully. It is camouflaging(read as KA-MUH-FLAA-ZHUNG). Camouflaging mean to hide in a surrounding by making it to hard to see.

Many animals and insects in nature uses camouflage to protect itself from its predators. Predators are animals which would attack and kill them. They use lots of techniques to blend in its surroundings.
Sometimes they use their natural body designs and patterns to resemble its surroundings like the moth sitting on the dry leaf.
Can you spot the leaf-insect hiding in the picture? It is using its resemblance to the surroundings to hide.

What about this lizard? This lizard is using its pattern on body as a disguise to approach the prey it wants to eat. Yes! Sometimes predators use its resemblance to nature to hide itself from prey so they wont escape easily.
Even big animals such as cheetah uses its spot to camouflage while hunting. Its spots are helpful to hide in the bushes and dry grasses.
Now spot the frog hiding in this picture. Some animals hide themselves by being so close to the ground. This helps them to remove their shadow and making hard for others to see.
This Mantis is using the same technique to camouflage.
Can you see the Gecko hiding on the bark of tree?
Where is the owl in this picture?
This one is really hard. Can you spot the plant hopper? No? Its sitting on the lower left stem with its two legs and the front legs on the thin stem.
We humans also use camouflage technique. The military uniforms are based on resemblance to the surroundings. The army planes painted are blue to minimize them being spotted.
